summary: Procure evaluation seats for ML Feature Store vendor with SSO, BYOK KMS, and compliance evidence
description:
Issue summary:
We need to procure a 30-day evaluation for an ML Feature Store product (vendor: FeatherStore) for the Feature Engineering and Data Platform teams. Evaluation requires 12 concurrent seats, SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning, BYOK integration with AWS CloudHSM, and EU data residency assurance for storage and logs. Security must provide SOC2 Type II report and completed security questionnaire (SIG). Procurement needs a PO estimate, billing cost center tag, and contract DPA addendum.

Impact:
- Enables Data Platform to validate feature storage, lineage, and online store latency before committing to Dedicated procurement.
- Blocking Data Science model rollouts that depend on low-latency feature lookups.
- Timeline: evaluation must be completed within 30 days to feed Q2 roadmap decision.

Environment / Scope:
- Staging account in eu-west region.
- 12 seats for engineers (data scientists and infra engineers).
- Sample datasets will be synthetic and production-like; vendor must guarantee EU residency for persistent storage and audit logs.

Requirements / Acceptance criteria:
1) Procurement: PO request for a 30-day evaluation, estimate ~USD 6,000 (vendor quote attached). Billing to cost center: PLATFORM-ENG-5602.
2) Identity: SAML SSO configured with Okta; SCIM provisioning tested for 12 users and one test group (feature-store-eval).
3) Security: BYOK integration verified using a test key provisioned in our AWS CloudHSM account; vendor provides integration steps and confirms no key material leaves customer HSM.
4) Compliance docs: vendor to upload latest SOC2 Type II report, pen-test summary, and completed SIG questionnaire to Confluence.
5) Data locality: vendor confirms EU-only storage (eu-west) and provides export controls for logs and backups.
6) Technical validation: two end-to-end test runs (ingest->featurecompute->online lookup) with p95 lookup latency < 15ms in staging.
7) Exit criteria: seats revoked or extended pending follow-up procurement; summary report and recommendations posted to Confluence.

Steps requested from teams (owner in parentheses):
- Procurement: raise PO and attach vendor quote, include PLATFORM-ENG-5602 billing tag, and include 30-day term (Assignee: Elena Gupta).
- Identity: coordinate with vendor on SAML metadata exchange and SCIM mapping; create test users (Assignee: Maya Chen).
- Security: request SOC2 and SIG; review BYOK integration plan and run the test key handshake in staging (Assignee: Jamal Aziz).
- Infra: allocate staging cluster and test dataset (Assignee: Tomas Lee).

Attachments:
- vendor-quote-featherstore-2026-03-08.pdf (provided by vendor)
- draft-eval-test-plan.md (link in Confluence page above)

Risks / Notes:
- Vendor currently lacks a published DPA; legal may require amendment before production. For eval, request short-term DPA addendum.
- BYOK workflows can add 3-5 days to onboarding; recommend parallelize SSO and procurement.
- If vendor cannot guarantee EU residency, we cannot proceed with production; evaluation may continue with data-masking but will be lower-fidelity.

Next steps:
1) Procurement: initiate PO and route to Finance for approval (Target: 2026-03-16).
2) Identity & Security: agree metadata exchange windows and schedule BYOK test (Target: 2026-03-18).
3) Infra: provision staging environment and seed test dataset (Target: 2026-03-17).
